Question: What is the main problem solved by using a database instead of an in-memory collection?
Options: A. It makes C# code shorter
B. It prevents the application from restarting
C. It allows data to persist after the application stops
D. It removes the need for MVC
CorrectAnswer: C. It allows data to persist after the application stops

Question: Which approach is being used when an existing database is used to generate EF Core entity classes?
What is the primary purpose of Entity Framework Core?
Options: A. To create HTML pages automatically
B. To replace the MVC Controller
C. To map objects in code to relational database data
D. To replace the C# compiler
CorrectAnswer: C. To map objects in code to relational database data

Question: Which EF Core component is primarily responsible for communicating with the database?
What does the following command primarily do? dotnet ef dbcontext scaffold "ConnectionString" Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer -o Models
Options: B. Creates a new MVC project
C. Generates EF Core models and a DbContext from an existing database
CorrectAnswer: C. Generates EF Core models and a DbContext from an existing database

Question: Where is a database connection string commonly stored in an ASP.NET Core MVC application?
A Student belongs to exactly one Section, while a Section can contain many students. What type of relationship is this?
In the following example, what is SectionId? public int SectionId { get; set; } public Section Section { get; set; }
What is the purpose of a navigation property such as public Section Section { get; set; }?
Options: A. It stores the database password
B. It represents a relationship to another entity
C. It creates a new database
D. It validates the student's name
CorrectAnswer: B. It represents a relationship to another entity

Question: What does .Include() generally allow EF Core to do?
Options: B. Load related Section data together with Students
CorrectAnswer: B. Load related Section data together with Students

Question: Why might a ViewModel be used when displaying Student and Section information?
Options: B. To combine or shape the data specifically needed by the view
C. To automatically create database tables
D. To prevent controllers from using LINQ
CorrectAnswer: B. To combine or shape the data specifically needed by the view

Question: Consider this query: var students = _context.Students.Include(s => s.Section).ToList(); What is the main benefit of Include(s => s.Section)?
Options: A. It loads the related Section navigation property
B. It creates a Section object manually
C. It removes the foreign key
D. It prevents the query from accessing the database
CorrectAnswer: A. It loads the related Section navigation property

Question: Which type of validation occurs in the browser before a request is sent to the server?
Why is server-side validation still necessary if client-side validation exists?
Options: A. Client-side validation can be bypassed
B. Client-side validation automatically modifies the database
C. Server-side validation only works with SQLite
D. Client-side validation cannot display messages
CorrectAnswer: A. Client-side validation can be bypassed
